# contenir/contenir-storage

> Framework-agnostic asset storage for Contenir CMS: local, S3-compatible and Cloudflare-transform backends behind one StorageInterface, with named image variants. PHP 8.3+.

Key facts for code generation:

- Build backends from config with `StorageConfig::fromArray($config['storage'], new ImageResizer(), $webRoot)`; use `$manager->primary()` or `$manager->get('r2')`.
- Paths are relative to the storage root, with no leading slash: `asset/news/photo.jpg`.
- `store(UploadInput::fromFilesArray($_FILES['f']), 'asset/news')` names the file from its detected type (`Holiday.JPG` with PNG bytes becomes `holiday.png`) and returns an `Entry`.
- `url($path, 'card')` returns null when the variant is not materialised; `variantUrls($path, 'card')` returns `['avif' => …, 'source' => …]` without I/O; `thumbnailUrl()` uses the `admin-thumb` variant.
- S3 variants are sibling keys `photo__card.avif`; local variants live at `_variant/card/photo.jpg`.
- A `dimensions` ladder named `card` produces variants `card-320`, `card-480`…; `storage.paths` decides which families a path owns.
- Optional capabilities: `MissingVariantsReporterInterface`, `BulkDeleteInterface`, `OnDemandVariantGeneratorInterface` (S3 only).
- Backends take an `ImageResizerInterface` (`new ImageResizer()` for ImageMagick). All concrete classes are final; extend through the interfaces.
- Use `InMemoryStorage` and `StubImageResizer` in tests. Catch `Exception\StorageException` (abstract) for any storage failure.
